subject: Technical panel scheduling & proctor notes — Alex Jensen (Sr. ML Engineer)
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@gmail.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: StaffingCo <recruiting+vendor@staffingco.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Technical panel scheduling & proctor notes — Alex Jensen (Sr. ML Engineer)

Hi Alex / Team,

Thanks for the quick responses on availability. I'd like to lock the technical screen for Alex (Sr. ML Eng) and get the panel logistics in place. Proposed slot:

- Monday, Feb 23 — 10:00–11:30 AM PT (90 minutes total; 2 interviewers + 15 min buffer)

Panel composition:
- Dev Patel (Backend / systems + coding) — primary for first 45 mins
- Markus Klein (Model & evals) — primary for second 45 mins

What I'll provide:
- CoderPad link for collaborative coding + a short systems question (coderpad link below)
- Short technical-briefing PDF for interviewers (attached)
- Calendar invite (attached .ics) — please accept so we can finalize rooms/overrides

Proctoring notes / candidate environment:
- Candidate will be given a CoderPad session with editor + test harness; no external internet access required.
- If the interviewer needs to run a private container, we'll use the ephemeral environment but avoid asking the candidate to install anything.

Alex — does Monday 10:00 PT work for you? If not, propose two alternative slots this week.

Attachments: alex_jensen_resume.pdf, technical-briefing-panel.pdf, invite.ics

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0193

--
Note: CoderPad session (read-only for observers): https://coderpad.io/p/rdw-ml-8421
Interview brief (internal): https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/interview-briefing/rdw-ml-panel-8421

From: Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@gmail.com>

Cc: StaffingCo <recruiting+vendor@staffingco.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:33:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Technical panel scheduling & proctor notes — Alex Jensen (Sr. ML Engineer)

Hi Sean / Tessa,

Thanks — Monday at 10:00 PT works great for me. A couple quick questions:

1) For the coding portion, will I be expected to import external libraries? I usually work in Python 3.10.
2) Time zone check: I am in PT (San Francisco). Confirmed.
3) Do you have instructions for the video link / proctoring window?

Also attaching my updated resume (same PDF name). Looking forward to the conversation.

Best,
Alex

Attachment: alex_jensen_resume.pdf

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@gmail.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Technical panel scheduling & proctor notes — Alex Jensen (Sr. ML Engineer)

Sean / Alex,

Monday 10:00 PT is on my calendar. Two quick notes from an interviewer perspective:

- For the coding problem we'll keep it to standard library + numpy allowed. No external installs. I'll state allowed imports at the top of the prompt.
- I'll need the CoderPad link ~5 minutes before the session. If possible, please make me a session editor so I can run tests and show canonical outputs.
- Can we ask Alex to share their screen when running code? If there's a need to run anything longer, we'll switch to the ephemeral runner (hosted by Redwood) but that should be unnecessary.

I reviewed the attached brief and left one comment in the doc re: expected complexity of the systems question. Minor tweak.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Senior Software Engineer, Infra
dev_patel@redwood.ai

From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@gmail.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 08:14:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Technical panel scheduling & proctor notes — Alex Jensen (Sr. ML Engineer)

Thanks, Dev — quick confirmations and links below.

- CoderPad: https://coderpad.io/p/rdw-ml-8421 (I'll create the session and add Dev/Markus as editors at 9:55 PT on Mon).
- Allowed languages: Python 3.10 (stdlib + numpy). We'll call that out in the pad preface.
- Screen sharing: Alex, please be ready to share your screen when you run through the pad; if you prefer not to, we can use the built-in pad execution outputs instead.
- Proctoring / video link: We'll use Meet link in the calendar invite. If the candidate has any connectivity issues, fallback is the phone number listed in the invite.

Internal note to interviewers: after the session please submit debrief within 24 hours using the rubric attached (panel-debrief-rubric.csv). Focus on: correctness, design tradeoffs, system-level reasoning, communication.

Attachments: panel-debrief-rubric.csv

I'll finalize the calendar invite and send the final confirmation to Alex + StaffingCo.

Thanks,
Sean
